summary: Public projects created on 27 April 2026: 10 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Agent plugins for Claude Code covered data annotation, digital printing, KDE plasmoid development, programmatic document generation, Linux packaging, and social discourse research. Other repositories included Hebrew fonts, a KDE Plasma time widget, and notes on prompt categorisation. A training dataset decomposed voice-typed podcast prompts into asks, context chunks, and host notes.

projects.name: Awesome Hebrew Fonts
projects.description: Collection of Hebrew fonts, installer for Google Font distributed versions, and some resources

projects.name: Claude Data Annotation Plugin
projects.description: End-to-end toolkit for turning raw data into an annotated dataset and publishing it to Hugging Face.

projects.name: Claude Digital Printing Plugin
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin with skills for preparing PDFs and documents for digital printing.

projects.name: Claude KDE Plasmoid Dev Plugin
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin that adds a skill for developing KDE Plasma plasmoids — desktop and panel widgets built in QML and packaged for the Plasma shell.

projects.name: Claude Programmatic Doc Generation Plugin
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin for building programmatic document generation pipelines.

projects.name: KDE Time Blocks Widget
projects.description: Modular KDE Plasma 6 desktop widget — local time, UTC, Gregorian date, and optional Hebrew calendar as reorderable cards

projects.name: Linux Packaging Plugin
projects.description: Skills for Linux packaging and release workflows — Debian/.deb builds, npm publishing, GitHub release creation, agent deploy scripts, and local debugging.

projects.name: Prompt Categorizer Notes
projects.description: Notes for a small classifier that splits prompts into prompt/context/host-instruction tracks for agentic pipelines

projects.name: Social Feedback Plugin
projects.description: Check what people are actually saying about a topic, product, or provider by searching curated social-discourse sources.

projects.name: Prompt Separation
projects.description: Voice-typed podcast prompt transcripts decomposed into structured fields: discrete prompts (asks), a list of context chunks, and free-form host_notes.
